original_text: The present analysis therefore provides a microscopic interpretation of the coupling parameter appearing in hydrodynamical descriptions of the neutron-star crust.

rationale: The paper computes the coupling constant for a single configuration (Z=28, μ_n=4 MeV) and explicitly defers systematic analysis to future work, so the added clause claiming universality across all inner-crust density regimes and cluster compositions is a sweeping overgeneralisation unsupported by the Results.
